title: Prompt Mint production dashboard
description: RPC latency, error rates, active users, transaction volume, and API endpoint health. Import into Grafana or view alongside Datadog.

panels.title: RPC call latency
panels.description: Soroban RPC round-trip latency by method. PagerDuty pages when P99 stays above 2s for 5 minutes.

panels.title: Error rates
panels.description: API and RPC error rates. Critical PagerDuty alert at >5 API errors/sec.

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: Privacy-safe active-user heartbeats from wallet connect and browse analytics events.

panels.title: Transaction volume
panels.description: Submitted Stellar transactions (purchase, listing, unlock-adjacent submits).

panels.title: API endpoint health
panels.description: 1 = healthy, 0 = failing. Pages PagerDuty when any scraped endpoint stays unhealthy for 2 minutes.

panels.title: Service Failures (5xx Errors)
panels.description: Unexpected API failures indicating a service degradation.

panels.title: API Request Duration (P99)
panels.description: API latency monitoring RPC delays or indexer lag.

panels.title: User Errors (Unlock Failures by Reason)
panels.description: User-facing errors such as invalid_signature or no_access (purchase failures/delays).

panels.title: Unlock Success vs Challenge Issued
panels.description: Conversion rate from challenge to successful unlock.

panels.title: Rate Limits Hit
panels.description: Volume of requests blocked by rate limiting.
